summary: A preexisting coverage gap remains: the harness cannot reach cJSON_Minify on a comment-only input because it returns when parsing fails. Full coverage cannot be established without the delegated build script.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: The supplied build recipe delegates to an unsupplied script.
This conditional CMake target does not establish how the delegated OSS-Fuzz recipe builds the entry.
The same build-path uncertainty remains after the change.
The entry gates its later operations on successful parsing.

claims.necessity_reason: Minification is an operation of this entry. A finite input with flags 1000 followed by //, a newline, and a NUL would be reduced to an empty string by cJSON_Minify, but the entry returns when parsing that input yields no JSON value. A successfully parsed JSON value cannot provide an equivalent whole-input result. This preexisting parse gate concerns the parser group g0002.

before.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to remove a whole-input single-line comment, producing an empty string.
before.reason: Minify handles the comment, while parse_value has no value case for the comment-only input. The harness returns on parse failure before calling Minify.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows how Minify consumes a single-line comment.
The parser's value dispatch cannot accept the comment-only input.
A failed value parse returns no item to the entry.

after.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to remove a whole-input single-line comment, producing an empty string.
after.reason: The minification contract and the harness's parse-success gate remain the same.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Minify is called only after the earlier parse-success gate.
